claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and monitor oxygenation/ventilation closely given severe hypoxemia and hypercapnia.
Continue vasopressor support (norepinephrine, vasopressin, phenylephrine) and monitor hemodynamics closely.
Obtain repeat arterial blood gas to reassess acid-base status and oxygenation.
Transfuse platelets given severe thrombocytopenia (platelet count 11-36 K/uL) and coagulopathy.
Monitor platelet count and coagulation parameters closely.
Continue sedation with propofol, midazolam, and fentanyl to maintain goal RASS -3 to -4.
Obtain blood cultures and continue broad-spectrum antibiotics (cefepime) for suspected infection given fever and leukocytosis.
Monitor temperature and treat fever with acetaminophen as needed.
Monitor renal function and electrolytes given acute kidney injury and hyperphosphatemia.
Obtain repeat chest imaging to evaluate pulmonary status.
